gloss: to utilize; to put to practical use

definitions.gloss: to utilize, to make use of, to put to practical use
definitions.explanation: To effectively use available resources, skills, knowledge, or opportunities for a practical purpose.

examples.japanese: ⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{活用|かつよう}する。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もっと→もっと：00798_motto⟧⟦{活用|かつよう}→活用：02620_katsuyou⟧すべきだ。
examples.english: We should make better use of this system.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{資源|しげん}→資源：03167_shigen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{活用|かつよう}して、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{産業|さんぎょう}→産業：01419_sangyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{生|う}み{出|だ}す→生み出す：10423_umidasu⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}み→取り組み：10403_torikumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。

notes:
A compound of {活|かつ} (lively, active) and ⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧ (use). Emphasizes making effective, productive use of something — not just using it, but leveraging it to its full potential. Very common in business, education, and policy contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{資源|しげん}→資源：03167_shigen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{活用|かつよう}する: to utilize resources
- ⟦{人材|じんざい}→人材：11426_jinzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{活用|かつよう}する: to make use of human talent
- ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{活用|かつよう}する: to leverage technology
- ⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{活用|かつよう}する: to utilize data
- ⟦{有効|ゆうこう}→有効：03645_yuukou⟧⟦{活用|かつよう}→活用：02620_katsuyou⟧: effective utilization

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{利用|りよう}する→利用する：21735_riyousuru⟧: to use, to utilize — more general; simply using something for a purpose
- ⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to use — the most neutral and basic term for using something
- ⟦{駆使|くし}→駆使：14682_kushi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to make full use of, to command — implies mastery and skillful deployment

USAGE:
The noun ⟦{活用|かつよう}→活用：02620_katsuyou⟧ also has a grammatical meaning: verb conjugation. In Japanese grammar studies, ⟦{活用|かつよう}→活用：02620_katsuyou⟧ refers to how verbs and adjectives change form.
